title: More ways to sign in
summary: Add Google and Microsoft sign-in while keeping the existing approved-email access checks.
changes: Approved roster members can sign in with Google or Microsoft once those providers are enabled in Supabase.
Microsoft sign-in requests the email scope required by Supabase, and both providers return to the existing Night Roster URL after authentication.
A successful social login still has to pass the existing active allowed_users email check before any roster data opens.
Email and password, password reset, passkeys, roster calculations, staffing, allocations and database permissions remain unchanged.
